support.name: Customer Support Assistant
support.description: Answers buyer and seller questions using help center knowledge. Reduces contact volume and improves self-service.
sampleQuestions: How do I return an item?
How do I contact a seller?
What is eBay Money Back Guarantee?
How do I track my order?

escalation.name: Agent Escalation Assistant
escalation.description: Guides Tier 1 agents through troubleshooting steps and resolution paths. Reduces escalations and compresses onboarding.
sampleQuestions: Buyer claims item not received, tracking shows delivered
Seller is asking how to appeal an INAD case
Account restricted due to low seller metrics
Buyer opened a chargeback — what are the steps?
When do I escalate to Trust & Safety?

analytics.name: Gen BI Analytics Assistant
analytics.description: Answers natural language questions about CX ticket data. Surfaces trends, drivers, and opportunities without SQL.
sampleQuestions: What is driving escalations this month?
Which contact reason has the lowest FCR?
How does CSAT vary by channel?
What are the top issues for new sellers?
Show me resolution time trends over the last 30 days
